At 09:05, Asha Ellery sends exactly: "The token is in the canvas dispatch locker." The report's content is not guaranteed to match the actual token location.

At 09:07, a reading record supplied to Asha Ellery states: "Bram Fiske received no content or notification from the 09:05 report." Asha Ellery accepts this particular record as definitive.

Bram Fiske trusts each fully read location report. A fully read report replaces the preceding location belief even when its content is false in the world. At 09:15, Asha Ellery alone makes an accurate private live check: the token is now in the canvas dispatch locker. Bram Fiske cannot access this check and receives no notice of it. Any movement between the timed checks occurs outside the reader's view without a movement notice. The token remains in this privately checked location through 09:20.
